name: ComfyUI-Intel-XPU
description: ComfyUI container with native PyTorch XPU support for Intel Arc GPUs. Designed and tested with Intel Arc Pro Battlemage GPUs using the Linux xe driver and Intel Level Zero runtime. Includes: - ComfyUI - Native PyTorch XPU - ComfyUI Manager - Hugging Face CLI - aria2 - Automatic ComfyUI model directory creation The Intel GPU must already be working on the Unraid host and exposed through /dev/dri. The exact render device may vary between systems. Verify your Intel GPU render device before installation.

paths.name: Models
paths.description: Host path for persistent ComfyUI models. Default assumes an Unraid share named AI. Change this path if you use a different share.

paths.name: Input
paths.description: Persistent ComfyUI input directory. Default assumes an Unraid share named AI. Change this path if you use a different share.

paths.name: Output
paths.description: Persistent directory for generated images and other ComfyUI output. Default assumes an Unraid share named AI. Change this path if you use a different share.

paths.name: Custom Nodes
paths.description: Persistent ComfyUI custom nodes directory. ComfyUI Manager is installed here automatically.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Persistent ComfyUI Intel XPU configuration directory.

variables.name: Hugging Face Token
variables.description: Optional Hugging Face access token for gated/private models. Leave blank if not required.

variables.name: Additional ComfyUI CLI Arguments
variables.description: Optional additional command-line arguments passed to ComfyUI at startup. Example: --disable-dynamic-vram --lowvram --cpu-vae --reserve-vram=1 --disable-smart-memory

variables.name: Additional Python Packages
variables.description: Optional space-separated Python packages installed at container startup. Example: opencv-python imageio_ffmpeg

devices.name: Intel GPU
devices.description: Intel GPU render device. Change this to the renderD### device belonging to your Intel Arc GPU.
